stories.title: Black Friday spending is evolving as shoppers look to stretch their holiday budgets
stories.summary: Holiday retail sales are projected to surpass $1 trillion nationwide this year, even as consumers look for ways to cut costs and stock up on everyday essentials.

stories.title: Port now says SEA Airport had 'limited' notice before ICE arrest
stories.summary: The Port has since clarified that SEA Airport and Port personnel received "limited" advance notice of Immigration and Customs Enforcement's (ICE) planned arrest.

stories.title: Top pole vaulter decides to go pro, forego senior year at UW
stories.summary: Hana Moll, the world's top ranked women's pole vaulter, is beginning her professional career with Adidas.

stories.title: Police investigate deadly vehicle vs. pedestrian crash in Lynnwood
stories.summary: All northbound lanes of Highway 99 in Lynnwood are closed for the investigation, police say.

stories.title: No active shooter at Alderwood Mall, police confirm
stories.summary: ​A small fight took place in the food court, and a table or chair was knocked over, which caused a loud noise and led to panic among shoppers, Lynnwood police said.

stories.title: Why a rare tornado warning went out on Thanksgiving in King County
stories.summary: Forecasters say a spotter's call and radar rotation prompted the Thanksgiving tornado warning in King County, which ended with no tornado and no damage.

stories.title: 5 things to do in western Washington: Nov. 27-29
stories.summary: Explore festive holiday events in western Washington, including Seattle's tree lighting, Tacoma's Zoolights, and Leavenworth's Christmas Town.

stories.title: Crystal Mountain Resort to open this weekend
stories.summary: Partial operations begin this weekend at Washington state's largest ski resort.

stories.title: Spokane man's generosity lives on two years after his passing through organ donation
stories.summary: As a Spokane family reflects on Ken Peacock's enduring generosity two years after his passing, his organ donations continue to transform lives.

stories.title: Deadly two-car collision closes U.S. 101 in Pacific County
stories.summary: The highway is fully blocked, and a detour is in place. Drivers should expect delays and use alternate routes if possible.

stories.title: Renton driver booked for vehicular homicide after SR 18 crash kills passenger
stories.summary: Troopers said the vehicle missed a curve on the C Street exit, crossed the median and hit a guardrail.

stories.title: Hikers caught outside during brief Tornado Warning in King County
stories.summary: The National Weather Service issued the warning after a trained spotter observed a landspout on Thanksgiving Day. The short warning expired at 12:15 p.m.
